changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE diary_entry ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, user_id BIGINT NOT NULL, when_started TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, when_ended TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, duration INTEGER NOT NULL, mood SMALLINT, description VARCHAR(1000), status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT fk_diary_user FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE );
CREATE INDEX idx_diary_user ON diary_entry (user_id); CREATE INDEX idx_diary_started ON diary_entry (when_started); CREATE INDEX idx_diary_status ON diary_entry (status);
